title: Plan: Qew v1 self-hosting work graph
goal: Build the complete Qew v1 lifecycle as a visible dependency graph.
done-when: Qew can apply this plan without duplicate work.
The queue, agent context, release, and GitHub projection are proven.

title: [WP00] Bootstrap Qew write lifecycle
goal: Give Qew the first guarded claim and completion path.
done-when: Start and complete have golden and refusal walks.

title: [WP01] Freeze v1 contracts and threat model
goal: Freeze vocabulary, command contracts, schemas, exits, and trust boundaries.
done-when: Implemented and planned behavior are distinct.
Output, exit, and threat contracts are explicit.

title: [WP02] Build the strict GitHub boundary
goal: Provide complete pagination, strict decoding, and least-authority GitHub calls.
done-when: Partial or malformed API responses fail closed.

title: [WP03] Build canonical graph model and output
goal: Model closed vocabulary, graph invariants, output, and Unicode findings.
done-when: Cycles and contradictions are reported.
Human and machine output have golden walks.

title: [WP04] Implement idempotent repository bootstrap
goal: Reconcile Qew labels and print bounded agent guidance.
done-when: Repeated initialization is safe and idempotent.

title: [WP05] Implement the vetted read suite
goal: Implement list, show, search, triage, blocked, and graph check.
done-when: Routine reads exclude unapproved content.
Every command seam has useful walks.

title: [WP06] Implement graph and issue mutations
goal: Implement canonical issue creation, editing, parents, and dependencies.
done-when: Cycles fail before writes.
Closed targets require an override.

title: [WP07] Finish ready and plan rollups
goal: Derive bounded priority-aware ready work and plan status.
done-when: Results are deterministic and incomplete graphs are refused.

title: [WP08] Implement guarded work lifecycle
goal: Implement guarded start, complete, close, and reopen.
done-when: Claims and lifecycle writes are verified.

title: [WP09] Add campaigns and GitHub Projects visibility
goal: Reconcile milestones and the GitHub Projects visibility surface.
done-when: Projection is idempotent and never becomes graph authority.

title: [WP10] Implement checkpointed plan application
goal: Validate, dry-run, and apply JSONL plans with safe resume.
done-when: Resume verifies the repository, plan digest, provenance, and completed writes.

title: [WP10A] Extend apply to campaigns and Projects
goal: Let one plan materialize its milestone and Project surface.
done-when: Campaign and Project mutations are checkpointed and verified.

title: [WP11] Implement linked pull request workflow
goal: Create draft or ready pull requests from safely claimed work.
done-when: Branch state, title, body, and one closing reference are guaranteed.

title: [WP12] Prime and session-hook program
goal: Deliver bounded vetted context and safe session-start integration.
done-when: Every supported hook child is complete.

title: [WP12A] Implement bounded qew prime
goal: Produce token-bounded vetted context from live Qew state.
done-when: Text and hook-oriented output remain measured and bounded.

title: [WP12B] Build safe hook configuration foundation
goal: Provide atomic idempotent editing for supported agent hooks.
done-when: Unrelated configuration is preserved and symlinks are refused.

title: [WP12C] Add Claude Code session-start hook
goal: Install and remove a Claude Code SessionStart hook for Qew prime.
done-when: A command walk proves context injection and removal.

title: [WP12D] Add Codex session-start hook
goal: Install and remove the Codex project hook for Qew prime.
done-when: The emitted hook and required trust step are documented and proven.

title: [WP12E] Add opencode session-start integration
goal: Install and remove an auto-discovered Qew prime plugin.
done-when: Install and removal preserve unrelated plugins.

title: [WP12F] Add Cursor session-start hook
goal: Install and remove the Cursor sessionStart hook for Qew prime.
done-when: The Cursor JSON context contract is proven.

title: Plan: Package and distribute Qew
goal: Make Qew installable through a trusted Python package workflow.
done-when: Installation works outside the checkout.
Release artifacts are auditable.

title: Package Qew for isolated installation
goal: Install Qew through an isolated Python application installer.
done-when: The installed executable passes a smoke walk.
Runtime dependencies remain explicit.

title: Publish Qew release provenance and SBOM
goal: Make release inputs and dependencies independently auditable.
done-when: The release publishes attestations, an SBOM, and hashes.

title: Document the complete Qew command synopsis
goal: Give humans and agents one scannable command reference.
done-when: Every implemented command and important parameter appears in one code block.

title: [WP13] Prove self-hosting and release Qew v1
goal: Use Qew to execute its graph, package it, and prove end-to-end behavior.
done-when: The complete plan validates through the installed package.
Golden and refusal walks exercise the installed package.
Operating documentation matches implemented behavior.
